sector_body: Construction Skill Development Council of India (CSDCI)
canonical_source_note: This pinned PDF (local_pdf_path, matched by sha256) is the SOLE canonical source for every NOS code, PC id, PC text, mark, and credit value used anywhere in P1 — qp.json, tasks.json, rubric.json, packs/ae-con-q0602/mapping/*.json, and every tool/validator under tools/ and ml/mapping/. No other Assistant Electrician document, no other QP revision, and no NQR portal listing may be used to add, correct, or override any field derived from this pack. If NSDC publishes a newer version, it is pulled in as a new pack version (e.g. v5.0-r1) with its own pinned PDF and its own sha256 — never merged into this one. See docs/qp_source_reconciliation.md for why the public NQR record can look different from this file without that being a discrepancy to 'fix'.
do_not_mix: Do not substitute PC text, marks, or NOS codes from any other Assistant Electrician document version (e.g. v2.0, v3.0) even if it is still published somewhere.
Do not substitute data from a different NQR entry revision of the same QP code.
Do not substitute data from a different QP code entirely, even within the same sector (Construction).

A thresholds.json match-coverage value (0.60 / 0.35) is an MVP matching heuristic invented for this project — it is not and must never be presented as an official NQR/CSDCI pass threshold. See packs/ae-con-q0602/mapping/thresholds.json.mvp_disclaimer.
